title: how are you all detecting regime shifts? my bot always notices too late
author: ZrTrue
selftext:
been building an automated crypto futures bot for a few months, llm-assisted like a lot of people here. strategy side is solid, the wall im stuck on is regime detection. my trend setups get chopped to death the second the market goes sideways, and my system always seems to "realize" the regime flipped after it already gave back a chunk.

curious what's actually worked for you all live, not just in backtest. simple adx/atr or a moving avg regime filter? vol regime stuff? an actual ml classifier? higher timeframe structure? or something dead simple that just holds up?

the backtest-to-live dropoff on the regime piece has been rough so im more interested in what's survived real conditions than what looks clean on history. appreciate any insight 🙏

comments.author: Outrageous_Band9708
comments.body:
welcome to the single hardest part of the system. 

there is no bulletproof way to do this. if there was, major quant firms would be raking people over the coals.

i've spent weeks developing my own, and I only kinda got something that sort of works.

my ML for regime failed and im using simple rules. but even those aren't perfect.

keep trying new ideas. query fable while you have access.

comments.author: ViperG
comments.body: Crystal ball is required, move along citizen
